content:
- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast by 3–5% for sentiment > 0.6.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (forecast > true by >10%) — apply downward correction of 5–10% if sentiment drops below 0.4.
- Lagged price declines (forecast still high while true drops) — adjust downward by 2–4% for each day after a sentiment dip below 0.3.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >15% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5–8% unless sentiment is strong (0.6+).
- Overshoot after spikes: if forecast peaks >10% above prior 3-day high, cap at 10% above that high unless sentiment is bullish.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overestimate in low sentiment (avg < 0.3) — reduce by 5–10% if sentiment < 0.3 for 3+ consecutive days.
